messages:
tiffany wu: hey all — new hire here, trying my first Buildkite job and it fails at the docker pull step. not sure what to check first.

omar diaz: welcome tiffany! can you paste the error and whether you're on k8s agents or EC2? most image issues are IAM or missing imagePullSecret.

tiffany wu: on k8s agents. error snippet: 
```
ERROR: Denied: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/buildkite-agent-role/i-0fff is not authorized to perform: ecr:GetAuthorizationToken on resource: *
```

noah green: that looks like the node/service-account role is missing ecr permissions. devops-bot can confirm.

devops-bot: Tip: Buildkite agents running on EKS use the node IAM role or IRSA service account for ECR access. Ensure the role bound to the pod has: ecr:GetAuthorizationToken, ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability, ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer.

omar diaz: tiffany — do you have access to view the `buildkite` namespace? if not, ping infra to check the `imagePullSecrets` secret. i can check if the helm chart expected `buildkite-docker-creds`.

tiffany wu: i don't have namespace perms yet. i accepted the GitHub App invite yesterday though.

omar diaz: accepted GH app is good. i'll check cluster real quick.

omar diaz: quick fix option: we store a shared `buildkite-docker-creds` secret in the `buildkite` ns. infra can create it from the central CI account. also check the pipeline's `serviceAccountName` — if it's `buildkite-agent-sa` we rely on IRSA.

(omitted: omar runs checks)

omar diaz: ok i granted you `view` in `buildkite` and recreated the secret with the CI robot creds. also added the missing ecr actions to the role.

tiffany wu: restarting the build now...

(30s later)

tiffany wu: build succeeded! image pulled fine. thanks so much.

noah green: i'll add a short note to the onboarding checklist: verify GH app, namespace view perms, presence of `buildkite-docker-creds`, and role ecr permissions.

tiffany wu: that would have saved me 20 minutes — appreciate it :smile:
